narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One gap is one and the other is twenty four. I say they are not proportional, because the gaps are different.
<bookmark mark='factor'/>Proportional asks about the factor, not the gap.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Gaps grow when the pot grows, so gaps cannot be the test.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Divide both terms by their highest common factor, then compare the simplest forms.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Are two to three and eight to twelve proportional?
